findings.evidence: The parent reran the retained CreateOnly replacement harness: a valid original envelope over an expired physical wrapper returns invalid-recovery-evidence. Installation keeps previous bytes while the recovery guard requires null.
The moving-clock harness reaches ArgumentOutOfRangeException after commit; compaction, transaction assembly and anchor cleanup separately sample the deadline check and TTL.
The anchor/private-replacement harness throws selected-value-missing at expiry. The first-pointer branch reads a decoded object and leaves priorDeadline null.

The parent reproduced compensation stopping after restoring its fence; retry returns recovery-manifest-unavailable. This is evidence destroyed by the new compensator itself, rather than initially insufficient legacy evidence.

A valid domain object with a top-level $hxrme receives Completed then JsonException/Nested expiry evidence in the parent rerun; old non-expiring objects are also classified by that newly introduced property.

FromBytes newly calls GetInt32 before kind validation and StartsWith before null validation. The harness reproduces InvalidOperationException where the baseline decoder returned null; a direct type/null validation repair preserves its contract.

The same expired-physical CreateOnly replacement completes under Resumable and returns transaction-dispatch Indeterminate under TransactionQualified in the parent harness. The transaction path retains empty create-only ETag.
The parent reproduced a 12,807-byte logical owner model expanding to 17,126 bytes; Execute reports Completed, then owner proof rejects it before decoding against the old 16,384-byte limit.

The new TimeSpan?/DateTimeOffset four-argument overload pair makes a formerly valid fourth default literal ambiguous (CS0121); preserving only the binary method signature did not preserve source calls.

The actual live scratch test manually recovers pending state and authors a delete batch after Abort. It does not execute the changed dispatcher cleanup; the approved proposal explicitly requires real production dispatcher qualification.
The same retained CreateOnly evidence mismatch is independently traced and reproduced as blind-1; verdict rendered before grouping.
The transaction CreateOnly physical-CAS mismatch is independently traced and reproduced as blind-7; verdict rendered before grouping.
The compensator removes its fence envelope before scratch settlement and then cannot validate a retry; parent reproduction confirms the exact described interruption.
The deadline check and remaining TTL are separate clock reads at the cited persistence paths; the moving-clock reproduction proves nonpositive provider retention is reachable.

ReadGenerationAsync chooses an inherited deadline before awaiting its physical read, then throws unconditionally on null without rechecking that chosen deadline. Expiry during that await reaches the claimed unavailable result.
Pre-verified gap: existing Abort tests seed non-expiring previous values and live expiry tests commit new candidates. No exercised restoration assertion would catch loss of the previous physical TTL.

Pre-verified gap: inherited-expiry and abandoned-replacement tests do not combine same-key replacement with an expiring selected previous pointer. Omitting PreviousExpiresAtUtc survives those separate tests.
The parent reproduced valid retained CreateOnly recovery refusal; installed previous bytes contradict the unchanged create-only previous-null recovery guard.
